items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well after we started working for her then work started coming regular out there.

ctx.x: Well I think first we went to Cincinnati, Ohio, then into Oxford and then after that we started traveling around because Hank got us out to Chicago and that's how the band got on the road. Start to travel around different places and the first thing you know we was going to California. So how we come to go out there this woman had heard about us, Rose Stammon and she had wrote Nick Gagliana and they started negotiating about the band. So George got us all together and asked us how we liked her. But we all agreed…
This was still with the same band with El Morroco.
